text: **Rust owns everything that matters; the UI just renders + dispatches.** Native/browser shells never choose mints, relays, or retry policy. They show a bounded "wallet" projection (balance, capabilities, pending ops) and fire typed actions (`create wallet`, `send nutzap`, `redeem`, `pay invoice`). All secret material — Cashu proofs, wallet private key — stays inside Rust and never crosses the FFI boundary.
